chapter: Pedal points, Hampton, Norvo and Debut
title: Origins of pedal points and Jelly Roll Morton
summary: Mingus on pedal point and what jazz is, learning of Morton's precedent, Miles years later, and the Debussy-like tags in his pieces.

story.theme_name: Teaching jazz: schools, students and advice to the young
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels
